    Open House - October 12, 2026

    Monday, October 12, 2026 at 8:00 AM until 5:00 PMEastern Daylight Time UTC -04:00

    Map and Directions

    J. Wayne Reitz Union
    686 Museum Road
    Gainesville, FL 32611
    United States

    Join us in The Swamp for our 2026 Open House!

    Open House is designed for prospective students who are current high school seniors. Participants and their two guests will be able to visit campus and learn about all that the University of Florida can offer.

    Participants will have the opportunity to engage with current students, UF’s undergraduate academic colleges, the Division of Student Life and the Office of Admissions to learn more about applying to and attending UF.

    Registration is no longer available because the registration deadline has passed.
